description.zh-CN: 翡翠配色的 CF Server Monitor 主题。
description.en: An emerald theme for CF Server Monitor.

description.zh-CN: 极简风格的 CF Server Monitor 主题。秒级全局节拍驱动实时数据，卡片/圆环/表格三种模式，支持价格、到期、流量包与剩余价值展示。
description.en: A minimal CF Server Monitor theme. Realtime data on a unified 1s tick, bar/ring/table card modes, with price, expiry, traffic quota and remaining-value display.

description.zh-CN: 清爽的卡片式主题。大 / 小 / 迷你 / 列表四种视图，实时更新，含三网延迟丢包、价格到期与流量统计。
description.en: A clean card-based theme. Four layouts (large / compact / mini / list), realtime updates, per-carrier latency and loss bars, plus price, expiry and traffic stats.

description.zh-CN: 为 CF-Server-Monitor 设计的扁平、简洁、现代且精确的仪表盘主题。
description.en: A flat, clean, modern, and precision dashboard theme for CF-Server-Monitor

description.zh-CN: 一款灵感来源于游戏《星露谷物语》的主题。
description.en: A theme inspired by the game Stardew Valley.
